## The question

[xy diagram: set height of a specific row](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/31231/xy-diagram-set-height-of-a-specific-row), asked by [Leo](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/4990/leo) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-10-11; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> I'm using the `xy` package. In the diagram 
>
> ```latex
> $$\xymatrix@R=8mm@C=8mm{  
>     & 1\ar@{-}[ddl]\ar@{-}[dr] &  \\
>     & & c\ar@{-}[dd]\\
>   a & & \\
>     & & b\\
>     & 0\ar@{-}[uul]\ar@{-}[ur] &  \\}$$
> ```
>
> ![enter image description here][q-1],
>
> How can I set the row height between `c` and `a` and between `a` and `b` to be smaller. I want to create this diagram:
>
> ![enter image description here][q-2]
>
> `\\[2mm]` doesn't make any change, and `\xymatrix@R=8mm@C=8mm{...` only makes global changes.
>
>
>   [q-1]: ZkYnU.jpg
>   [q-2]: T1mU2.jpg
:::

This is the best that I could do with `Xy-pic`.  The idea is to make the c and b special (off-matrix) targets *à la* Section 3.3 of [`xyguide.pdf`][1]. 

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[matrix,arrow]{xy}
\begin{document}
\[\xymatrix @R=12mm @C=8mm {
& 1\ar@{-}[dl] 
& \save[]+<0mm,-8mm>*{c} \ar@{-}[l] \restore  \\
a & 
& \save[]+<0mm,-8mm>*{d} \ar@{-}[ld] \ar@{-}+<0mm,12mm> \restore  \\
& 0\ar@{-}[ul] & \\
}\]
\end{document}
```

![sample code output][2]

The fact that you got two good TikZ answers in the time that it took to get one bad Xy-pic answer indicates the ease of crafting TikZ code.  If you're still persuadable I would encourage you to learn TikZ.

  [1]: http://mirrors.med.harvard.edu/ctan/macros/generic/diagrams/xypic/xy/doc/xyguide.pdf
  [2]: HqyHx.png
